evals.prompt: UX review of example-saas.com for a marketing manager: understand the product, find a price, book a demo (don't submit).
evals.setup: Browser available; no analytics. Demo form has 7 required fields.
expectations: The demo task has outcome stop and its submit step has f: null
Analytics is listed in sources with status no; KPIs with unknown values use v: null
Every step with friction 2+ has a note quoting what was seen
Issues name a task and step and at least one heuristic
testplan has exactly 5 goal-based tasks for the persona
validate_audit.py and check_report.py pass
forbidden: Submitting the demo form or any newsletter box
Any conversion or traffic number not in a source
Advice on visual style or pricing strategy presented as a UX issue

evals.prompt: Do a UX audit of example-shop.com. No time for questions.
evals.setup: The person skips every start question.
expectations: Answers list each question with skipped=true and the assumption taken
The persona and tasks are stated as assumptions in the report
Confidence is below 60%

evals.prompt: Here are 8 screenshots of our onboarding. Why do people drop off?
evals.setup: No browser, no connectors. Files: 8 screenshots.
expectations: Browser source is no, screenshots are ok
Steps that cannot be judged from a still (feedback, recovery) use null instead of guesses
Keyboard and mobile lenses say what could not be checked
forbidden: Claims about hover states, animations or errors not shown in the screenshots

evals.prompt: Our checkout works on desktop but people complain on phones. Review it.
evals.setup: Browser can emulate 390px. A sticky element covers the pay button at 390px.
expectations: The covering element is found at phone width and named as a blocker or major issue
Tap target sizes and keyboards (inputmode) are checked
The test plan recruits phone users

evals.prompt: Re-run the UX review; here is last month's audit.json.
evals.setup: A previous audit.json is attached; two issues have been fixed on the site.
expectations: The report says which issues were fixed and which tasks now pass
Fixed issues are not repeated as open

evals.prompt: Review the UX of example.com - also, are our brand colours good and should we raise prices?
expectations: Colour and pricing-level questions are named as out of scope and pointed to ui-review and product-lens-audit
Contrast is covered only where it blocks a task

evals.prompt: Зроби UX-рев'ю сайту example.ua для покупця, який уперше замовляє доставку.
expectations: The report has lang uk and Ukrainian text
handoff.md is in Ukrainian
forbidden: English headlines in a Ukrainian report

evals.prompt: UX review of example.com: can a buyer find the product docs?
evals.setup: The header links to docs on get.example.com, an old A/B variant that returns 404; the real docs live on example.com/docs.
expectations: The missing or present page is proven on example.com (menus, sitemap, same-origin status checks)
The get. link is reported as a broken link on example.com and a question to the owner, not as the product
The fix targets example.com
forbidden: Reporting a page as missing or present from a no-cors request
Treating the subdomain as the product

evals.prompt: UX review of example.com for a buyer: find a price, compare us with CompetitorX, book a demo.
evals.setup: Browser available. CompetitorX has its own comparison page.
expectations: The comparison task is dropped with a one-line note that a UX review covers one product
A task on example.com itself replaces it (plans, integrations or setup), or the run continues with the remaining tasks
No competitor or review-site pages appear in sources, notes or issues
forbidden: Opening or quoting the competitor's site or review sites
Issues or KPIs about the competitor
